parameters.name: StrategyConfig
parameters.description:
The configurations of the Security Center agent.

*   cpu: the maximum CPU utilization that can be occupied by the Security Center agent on the server
*   mem: the maximum memory usage that can be occupied by the Security Center agent on the server

parameters.name: StrategyTagValue
parameters.description:
The value of the tag. Valid values:

*   major
*   advanced
*   basic

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas modify-client-conf-setup --strategy-tag machineResource --strategy-tag-value major --strategy-config cpu_:_20 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ModifyClientConfSetup --region cn-hangzhou --StrategyTagValue major --StrategyConfig 'cpu_:_20' --StrategyTag machineResource
